articles.title: Bread Before Grammar
articles.summary: A new apprentice can recite the grammar of the northern city but cannot understand a customer holding up two fingers.
articles.summaryZh: 一名新学徒背得出外城语法，却在面包店里听不懂顾客伸出的两根手指。
storyParagraphs: Alan came to North City and found work as an apprentice in a bakery. Every morning she memorised grammar tables and could explain how verbs changed, yet the customers' short, rapid orders escaped her. During her first week, she packed round loaves instead of long ones and mistook a collection for tomorrow as an order to take away immediately.

The baker did not give her another book. He placed Alan beside the counter and let her watch him take orders. As customers spoke, he pointed to the bread, raised the quantity on his fingers, and wrote the collection day on the bag. Every unfamiliar sentence contained some words Alan knew; the rest could be inferred from gestures and objects in front of her.

After several days, the baker repeated only when necessary and stopped translating every word. Alan first caught 'two', 'rye', and 'evening', then noticed how they moved through different orders. She began confirming with short sentences, and customers nodded or corrected her.

At the end of the month, a traveller requested a filled bread the shop had never sold. He used a word Alan did not know, but pointed to a hollow ring loaf and mimed putting jam inside. Alan picked up a knife and cut one open. The traveller smiled at once.
After closing, she put the morning's grammar sheet back into her book and first wrote the new order on a paper bag.
storyParagraphsZh: 阿岚来到北城，在面包店找到一份学徒工作。她每天清晨背语法表，能说出动词怎样变化，却听不懂顾客说得又快又短的订单。第一周，她把圆面包装成长条，把明天取货听成当场带走。
店主没有再给她一本书。他让阿岚站在柜台旁，看自己接单。顾客说话时，店主会指向面包、举起数量，再把取货日期写在纸袋上。陌生句子里总有一些阿岚认识的词，剩下的意思能从手势和眼前的东西猜到。
几天后，店主只在必要时重复一句，不再把每个词翻译出来。阿岚先听懂“两个”“黑麦”和“傍晚”，随后注意到它们在不同订单里怎样换位置。她开始用短句确认，顾客也会点头或改正。
月底，一名旅人要一种店里从未卖过的夹馅面包。他用了阿岚不认识的词，却指了指空心圆饼，又做出放入果酱的动作。阿岚拿出刀，切开一只面包，旅人立刻笑了。
收店后，她把早晨的语法表夹回书里，先在纸袋上写下了第二天的新订单。
explanationParagraphs: Comprehensible input is language whose overall meaning a learner can understand while it still contains unfamiliar forms or words. Context, known language, visual clues, repetition, and interaction make meaning accessible. It is widely considered important for acquisition, but not sufficient on its own; attention, output, feedback, memory, identity, and motivation also shape learning.
explanationParagraphsZh: 可理解输入是学习者能够把握整体意义、同时仍包含部分新语言的输入。情境、已知词语、视觉线索、重复与互动能让意义进入。它被广泛视为语言习得的重要条件，但并非唯一条件；注意、输出、反馈、记忆、身份与动机也会影响学习。

articles.title: The Error That Kept Moving
articles.summary: An apprentice's errors do not disappear; every few weeks they move to a different part of the sentence.
articles.summaryZh: 一名学徒的错误没有消失，只是每隔几周便换到句子的另一处。
storyParagraphs: When Mia came to the harbour city to learn trade, she could only replace the words of her home language one by one with harbour words. Her sentence order sounded strange, but people could usually understand. The shopkeeper restated every sentence for her and expected the mistakes to disappear quickly.

Several weeks later, Mia learned where the action word belonged. Her earlier errors declined, but she began adding the same past ending to every verb. The rule worked for most and failed on several exceptions. The shopkeeper thought her speech had become worse because these new mistakes had not appeared before.

Mia took responsibility for more orders. When rushed, she returned to shorter sentences; when prepared, she used recently learned forms. She was not simply knowing something one day and forgetting it the next. Different pressures brought different parts of her developing system forward.

The elderly bookkeeper kept three months of her orders and arranged them by date. The earliest copied the order of her home language. The middle pages showed one new rule applied too widely. The latest began separating a few exceptions. Her errors were not scattered; they moved as her rules changed.
The next time Mia wrote one of the exceptional verbs, she added the usual ending, paused, and rubbed it away.
storyParagraphsZh: 米娅到港城学做生意时，只会把家乡语逐词换成港城词。她说出的句子顺序奇怪，却勉强能被听懂。掌柜每次都替她重说一遍，希望那些错误很快消失。
几周后，米娅学会把动作词放到正确位置，旧错误少了，却开始给所有过去的动作加同一个词尾。规则适用于大多数词，也被她用在几个例外上。掌柜以为她学得更差，因为从前没有犯过这些新错。
米娅负责的订单越来越多。忙时，她又会退回短句；准备充分时，则能使用新学到的形式。她不是今天会、明天忘，而是在不同压力下调用不同做法。
老账房把她三个月的订单留了下来，按日期排开。最早的句子照搬家乡语，中间的句子出现一条过宽的新规则，最近的句子开始把少数例外分开。错误并非散乱地堆着，而是在随着她的规则移动。
下一次写到那个例外词时，米娅先添上常用词尾，停了一下，又把它擦掉。
explanationParagraphs: Interlanguage is the developing language system constructed by a learner from prior language, target-language input, internally generated rules, and communication strategies. Errors often reveal the current system rather than random failure. The system reorganises and varies with task, attention, and pressure, while some forms may stabilise before reaching target use.
explanationParagraphsZh: 中介语是语言学习者在发展中建构的语言系统，受既有语言、目标语输入、内部规则与交流策略共同影响。错误常是当前规则的证据，而非随机失败。该系统会重组，也会随任务、注意和压力变化；部分形式还可能在未达目标语前稳定下来。

articles.title: The Red Line Beneath the Ending
articles.summary: A tailoring apprentice understands what customers want but writes 'delivered yesterday' and 'deliver tomorrow' as the same sentence.
articles.summaryZh: 一名裁缝能听懂顾客要什么，却总把“昨天送”和“明天送”写成同一句话。
storyParagraphs: Tailoring apprentice Isha understood most orders. She rarely confused fabric, size, or colour. Delivery dates were different. In the harbour language, a very soft sound at the end of the action word marked something already completed. Isha understood the sentence as a whole but never registered that small sound.

Once, she wrote 'deliver tomorrow' for an order that had already been delivered yesterday, and the shopkeeper searched for the parcel for hours. He did not repeat the entire sentence more loudly. He placed the two orders side by side, drew a red line beneath the only different ending, and read them aloud.

After that, Isha still listened first for meaning, but paused when dates appeared. She marked whenever a customer used the ending and compared her own sentences with corrected ones. At first, she could see the feature without using it reliably.

Several weeks later, a customer spoke quickly. Isha was about to write tomorrow when her pencil stopped. She asked the customer to repeat the sentence, heard the soft ending, and turned to the previous day's page to find the completed order.
That evening, she removed the red thread from the old slips and wound it around the end of her pencil.
storyParagraphsZh: 裁缝学徒伊莎已经能听懂大部分订单。顾客说布料、尺寸和颜色，她几乎从不弄错。只有交货日期常出问题：港城语会在动作词尾加一个很轻的音，表示事情已经发生，伊莎听见整句话的意思，却从未留意那个小音。
一次，她把“昨天已经送到”记成“明天送到”，掌柜找了半天货。掌柜没有再大声重复整句，而是把两张订单并排放下，用红线划出唯一不同的词尾，再读给她听。
此后，伊莎在接单时仍先听意思，但遇到日期便会停一下。她开始在顾客说过那个词尾时做一个小记号，也会比较自己说的句子与对方改过的句子。起初她只是看得见，还常常用错。
几周后，一名顾客说得很快。伊莎已经准备写下明日，笔尖却停住了。她请对方再说一遍，这次听见那个轻音，翻到前一天的送货页，找到了已经完成的订单。
当晚，她把红线从旧订单上拆下来，绕在自己的铅笔末端。
explanationParagraphs: The noticing hypothesis proposes that a learner must consciously register a language feature in input for it to become available for acquisition. Attention may concern a form, its link to meaning, or a gap between current and target use. Noticing does not guarantee immediate mastery, but salience, task demands, feedback, and interaction influence what enters learning.
explanationParagraphsZh: 注意假说主张，学习者需要在输入中有意识地登记某个语言特征，它才可能成为习得材料。被注意的可以是形式、形式与意义的联系，或自身表达与目标形式的差距。注意并不保证立即掌握，但显著提示、任务需要、反馈与互动会影响什么进入学习。

articles.title: The Blue That Changed Name Across the Bridge
articles.summary: A dye apprentice believes one shade of blue can have only one name until the same barrel crosses a bridge.
articles.summaryZh: 染坊学徒确信一种蓝色只能有一个名字，直到同一桶染料被推过了桥。
storyParagraphs: The eastern dyehouse called one deep blue 'wulan'. Apprentice Afu had heard the word since childhood and felt that its sound naturally belonged to night-coloured cloth. On his first delivery west of the river, the customer said she had ordered 'solan', not wulan.

Afu opened the barrel. The colour matched the sample exactly, yet the customer insisted that the name was wrong. As the argument sharpened, an old western dyer brought out his colour book. The same cloth appeared beside solan, while wulan did not appear anywhere.

Afu pushed the barrel back onto the bridge and met an eastern merchant. One glance was enough for the man to say, 'Isn't that wulan?' The colour had not changed in the middle of the bridge. What changed was the name each side had long used.

Before the next delivery, Afu did not invent a private compromise word. He wrote the eastern and western names on opposite sides of one wooden label and fixed the same sample between them. Customers on either bank could verify the order.
In time, dye soaked the label and blurred both words, while the blue cloth in the centre remained firmly attached.
storyParagraphsZh: 河东染坊把一种深蓝叫作“乌岚”。学徒阿伏从小听惯这个词，觉得它听起来本来就像夜色。第一次替师傅去河西交货时，顾客却说自己订的是“索蓝”，不是乌岚。
阿伏打开桶盖。颜色与样布完全一样，顾客仍坚持名称写错了。两边越争越急，最后河西老染工拿来自己的色册。“索蓝”旁边贴着同样的布，而“乌岚”在他的册子上根本不存在。
阿伏把染料推回桥上，又遇见河东商人。商人看了一眼便说：“这不是乌岚吗？”桶里的颜色没有在桥中央改变，改变的是两边人长期使用的叫法。
第二次送货前，阿伏没有自己发明一个折中的新词。他在木牌两面分别写上河东与河西的名称，并把同一块样布钉在中间。两边顾客都能据此确认订单。
后来木牌被染料浸湿，两个词渐渐模糊，中央那块蓝布仍牢牢钉着。
explanationParagraphs: Arbitrariness of the sign means that most linguistic forms have no necessary natural bond with what they signify, allowing communities to use different sounds or words for similar experience. Arbitrary does not mean individually changeable at will: social convention, contrast, history, and repeated use stabilise signs. Some iconicity and sound symbolism remain partly motivated.
explanationParagraphsZh: 符号任意性指多数语言形式与其所指之间不存在必然自然联系，因此不同共同体可以用不同声音或词语组织相近经验。任意不等于个人可以随意命名；社会约定、对比关系、历史与反复使用会让符号稳定。部分象似与语音象征则具有一定动因。

articles.title: Three Windows in the Burning Lighthouse
articles.summary: A writer interviews three witnesses to a fire and finds that each believes they saw the whole night.
articles.summaryZh: 作家采访了三名火灾见证者，发现每个人都确信自己看到的是完整的一夜。
storyParagraphs: Writer Wen Xue set out to tell the story of a lighthouse fire. The keeper said flames rose from below the stairs, trapping him at the top with smoke and a window that would not open. A child on shore said the keeper stood motionless in the light, as if refusing to escape. The rescue captain said he could not see the top at all as his boat avoided falling timber.

Wen Xue combined the three accounts so that readers knew at once where the fire began, when the boat arrived, and what the keeper thought. The story was clear, but no one had experienced such clarity. After reading it, the keeper asked, 'How could I know in the smoke that the boat had already passed the rocks?'

She began again. The first chapter contained only what the keeper could hear and see; the rescue boat entered his world only when it answered the bell. The second followed the captain, for whom the person above was only a blurred shape. In the child's chapter, neither the staircase nor the reason for the boat's delay was visible.
The fire remained the same, but the order of information changed. The keeper's chapter carried fear, the captain's demanded decisions, and the child's made the waiting long.
In the final manuscript, Wen Xue drew a window facing a different direction at the start of each chapter. She drew no window that could see the whole lighthouse at once.
storyParagraphsZh: 作家闻雪要写灯塔失火的故事。守塔人说，火从楼梯下方升起，他被困在顶层，只看见烟和一扇打不开的窗。岸边孩子说，守塔人一直站在亮处不动，像是没有逃跑。救援船长却说，自己靠近时始终看不见塔顶，只顾躲开落下的燃木。
闻雪把三段证词揉成一篇，让读者同时知道火从哪来、船何时到、守塔人在想什么。故事十分清楚，却没有人真正经历过这样的清楚。守塔人读后问：“我在烟里怎么会知道船已经转过礁石？”
她重新落笔。第一章只写守塔人能够听见和看见的事，远处的救援船直到钟声回应时才进入他的世界。第二章转到船长，塔顶的人只剩一道模糊影子。孩子那一章则看不见楼梯，也不知道船为何迟迟不靠岸。
同一场火没有改变，读者得到消息的先后却完全不同。守塔人那一章令人恐惧，船长那一章充满判断，孩子那一章则让等待显得漫长。
定稿时，闻雪在每一章开头画了一扇不同方向的窗。她没有画一扇能同时看见全部灯塔的窗。
explanationParagraphs: Focalization concerns the perspective or consciousness through which narrative information is selected: who can perceive, know, and understand what. It differs from who narrates. Internal, external, shifting, or multiple focalization changes information order, uncertainty, sympathy, and surprise. No single perspective automatically equals an objective whole.
explanationParagraphsZh: 叙事聚焦关注故事信息通过谁的感知或认知被选择，也就是谁能看见、知道和理解什么。它不同于谁负责讲述。内部、外部、切换或多重聚焦会改变信息顺序、不确定性、同情与惊奇，并不存在自动等同于客观全貌的单一视角。

articles.title: That Door Is Still Open
articles.summary: An innkeeper says something perfectly true, but the new waiter fails to hear the request inside it.
articles.summaryZh: 客栈老板说了一句完全正确的话，新伙计却没有听见其中的请求。
storyParagraphs: Afraid of misunderstanding the northern language, new waiter A-Luo promised himself that he would follow words exactly. One evening, as he carried plates past the counter, the innkeeper looked toward the cold wind outside and said, 'That door is still open.' A-Luo looked too and answered, 'Yes,' before continuing to the dining room.

The wind scattered account papers and weakened the fire. While closing the door, the innkeeper asked why A-Luo had done nothing. A-Luo replied that he had heard only a statement of fact. The innkeeper frowned. 'Both my hands were carrying a wine cask, and I kept looking at the door.'

The next day, a guest stared at an empty cup and said, 'Tea arrives very slowly here.' A-Luo was about to explain that the pot was nearby when he noticed the guest's hand waiting beside the cup. He poured tea first, then asked whether more hot water was needed. The guest's expression softened.

A-Luo did not begin treating every sentence as an order. When someone said, 'The window is open,' he checked the wind, the speaker's actions, and the current task. If a wrong guess could matter, he asked directly, 'Would you like me to close it?'
That night, the innkeeper passed with another wine cask. Before he spoke, A-Luo reached out and lowered the door bar.
storyParagraphsZh: 新伙计阿罗害怕听错北城话，便发誓只按字面办事。一天夜里，他端着盘子经过柜台，老板看了看外面的冷风，说：“那扇门还开着。”阿罗也看了一眼，回答：“是的。”随后继续送菜。
风把账纸吹落满地，炉火也暗了。老板关门时问阿罗为什么不动，他说自己听见的只是一个事实。老板皱着眉：“我两只手都在搬酒桶，眼睛还一直看着门。”
第二天，一名客人望着空杯说：“这里的茶来得很慢。”阿罗正要解释茶壶离得并不远，忽然看见客人的手仍放在杯边。他先添了茶，再确认是否还需要热水。客人的眉头松开了。
阿罗没有从此把每句话都猜成命令。有人在仓库说“窗户开着”时，他会看看风、说话人的动作和当时的任务；若一项误解可能造成损失，他就直接问：“您是要我关上吗？”
那晚老板再次抱着酒桶经过。还没等他说话，阿罗已经伸手把门闩落下。
explanationParagraphs: Pragmatics studies how utterance meaning depends on context, speaker intention, shared knowledge, social relations, and listener inference. A declarative sentence can also perform a request, warning, or criticism. Inference is constrained by words and public cues rather than free guessing; when consequences are serious or evidence is weak, clarification is safer.
explanationParagraphsZh: 语用学研究话语意义如何依赖语境、说话者意图、共同知识、社会关系和听者推断。陈述句可以同时承担请求、提醒或批评等行动。推断并非任意猜测，而要依据语言形式与公开线索；当后果重大或线索不足时，澄清比自信猜测更可靠。

articles.title: Water That Could Flow Only Once
articles.summary: One night of canal water can save newly planted trees or pay for a repaired roof, but cannot do both.
articles.summaryZh: 一夜渠水可以救活新栽的果树，也可以换来修屋顶的钱，却不能同时做两件事。
storyParagraphs: During the dry season, each household received canal water for one night. Meilin's newly planted peach trees had begun curling at the leaves. A melon grower from the next village offered twelve silver pieces for her turn, enough to repair the roof that leaked whenever it rained.

Meilin asked the water keeper what she would have to pay if she used her own share. He said the old agreement charged nothing. For a moment, she thought sending water into the orchard would cost nothing, until the melon grower placed twelve coins on the table and asked one final time before sunset.

She turned the gate toward the peach trees. Water entered the furrows and soaked the roots, while bowls would still be needed beneath the roof during the next rain. A neighbour remarked that at least the water had been free. Meilin placed the grower's written offer inside her account book.

The trees survived into autumn but were not yet bearing fruit. When someone asked whether the night had been worthwhile, Meilin did not add together everything else she might have done. She compared the future orchard with the roof repair that had actually been available.
Before the next year's water turn, Meilin placed the old twelve-coin offer beside the gate and only then moved the wooden handle.
storyParagraphsZh: 旱季里，每户只有一夜用渠水。梅林刚栽下的桃树开始卷叶，邻村瓜农却愿意出十二枚银币买下她的水时。那笔钱正够修补漏雨的屋顶。
梅林问水官用了自家的水要交多少钱。水官说渠水按旧约不收费。她一度觉得把水引进桃园便没有成本，直到瓜农把十二枚银币摆在桌上，又在日落前最后问了一次。
她最终把闸门转向桃园。水沿土沟慢慢浸进树根，屋顶仍要在下一场雨中接盆。邻居说幸好这水是免费的，梅林却把瓜农留下的报价纸收进账本。
秋天，桃树活了下来，却还不能结果。有人问她这一夜值不值得，她没有把所有没做的事加在一起，只比较那片未来的桃园与当时真正能够换到的修屋钱。
第二年分水前，梅林把那张十二枚银币的旧报价放在闸门旁，然后才转动木柄。
explanationParagraphs: Opportunity cost is the value of the next-best feasible alternative forgone when a choice is made. It can involve money, time, output, experience, or risk. Even a resource that is free to use has an opportunity cost when it is scarce and can serve only one purpose. It is not the sum of every unchosen possibility.
explanationParagraphsZh: 机会成本是一项选择所放弃的次佳可行方案的价值。它不只包括支付的钱，也可能是时间、产出、体验或风险；即使资源免费使用，只要它稀缺且只能用于一处，选择仍有成本。机会成本不是所有未选方案的总和。

articles.title: The Tenth Boat
articles.summary: The first nine ferries earn money, so their owner assumes the tenth should not remain on shore.
articles.summaryZh: 前九艘渡船都赚了钱，船主便认定第十艘也不该留在岸边。
storyParagraphs: For three nights of the Lantern Festival, the ferry landing overflowed with travellers. Owner Lusen sent out nine boats, each full and earning far more than on an ordinary evening. One old vessel remained at the bank. He wanted all ten boats carrying lanterns so that this would be remembered as the ferry's busiest year.

The tenth boat had no regular crew. Lusen would have to pay people who had already worked all day. The tide was turning faster, while only scattered passengers remained. His bookkeeper reminded him that the excellent earnings of the first nine boats would not pay the extra crew, lamp oil, and night risk of the next one.

Lusen still ordered the old boat pulled to the water. The crew named their overtime price, and the repairer found a mooring line that had to be replaced. Half the waiting passengers decided to travel in the morning. The money from this one trip had fallen below the cost of sending it safely.

Looking at nine strings of lights moving across the river, Lusen removed the lantern just hung on the old boat. On the second evening, when more passengers arrived, he compared what one additional trip could carry with what it would require and then launched the tenth boat.
After the festival, the accounts of the first nine vessels were not used to prove that every trip was worthwhile. The old boat's lantern hung beside a page of its own.
storyParagraphsZh: 灯节三日，渡口挤满旅客。船主陆森先后开出九艘船，每艘都坐满，赚来的钱远高于平日。岸边还有一条旧船，他想把十艘船全部挂上灯，好让今年成为渡口最兴旺的一年。
第十艘船没有固定船员，需要从已经工作整天的人里加钱请人。潮水也开始转急，只剩零散旅客等候。账房提醒他，前九艘的总收益再好，也不会替第十艘支付额外船员、灯油和夜航风险。
陆森仍让人把旧船拖到水边。船员报出加班价，修船匠又发现一根缆绳必须更换。等候的旅客中，一半决定明早再走。第十艘可能收到的钱，已经少于让它安全开出的花费。
陆森看着河面上九串移动的灯，解下旧船刚挂好的灯笼。第二晚旅客增多时，他重新比较这一趟能多带多少人、需要多付什么，才让第十艘离岸。
灯节结束后，九艘船的账没有被拿来证明任何一趟都值得开。旧船的那只灯笼单独挂在最后一页旁。
explanationParagraphs: Marginal analysis compares the additional benefit and additional cost of increasing or reducing an activity by one unit from its current level. The relevant decision concerns the next unit, not past totals or averages. As capacity, timing, risk, and demand change, the value and cost of one more unit change as well.
explanationParagraphsZh: 边际分析比较在当前水平上再增加或减少一个单位所带来的额外收益与额外成本。决策取决于“下一单位”而非过去总量或平均表现。随着容量、时间、风险与需求变化，新增一单位的价值和成本也会改变。

articles.title: The Price That Travelled Downstream
articles.summary: An upstream dyehouse offers the lowest prices in town while people downstream begin paying for the same dye.
articles.summaryZh: 上游染坊把布价降到全镇最低，下游的人却开始为同一桶染料付账。
storyParagraphs: Mr He owned an upstream dyehouse. After removing its settling pond, he could finish cloth faster and charge less than his rivals. Orders increased, workers kept their jobs, and customers praised the business. Dark water left through a rear ditch and entered the river without appearing on any invoice.

Downstream launderers found grey marks on white cloth and bought more clean water. Vegetable growers paid workers to clear dye residue from irrigation channels. Mr He said that he had already paid for dye, fuel, and wages. The downstream losses were not purchases he made and did not reduce his orders.

One day, the town council placed three account books together: the dyehouse's savings, the launderers' higher water costs, and the growers' clearing bills. The low price had not removed those expenses. It had sent them downriver to people who had taken no part in the dyeing.

The council required the settling pond to be restored and charged for discharged dye water. Cloth prices rose slightly. Mr He feared losing business, but every dyehouse faced the same rule. The number of downstream clearings began to fall each month.
At month's end, Mr He added a new line between dye and fuel in his ledger: river treatment.
storyParagraphsZh: 何老板的染坊在上游。他省去沉淀池后，染布更快，价格也比别家低。订单增加，工人保住了饭碗，顾客都说他经营得好。染完的黑水从后沟流进河里，没有出现在任何一张账单上。
下游洗衣人发现白布总带灰斑，只得多买清水。菜农的灌溉沟堵满染渣，每月都要雇人清理。何老板说自己已经支付染料、柴火和工钱，下游的损失并不由他购买，也没有减少他的订单。
一天，镇议会把三本账摆在一起：染坊节省的钱、洗衣人增加的水费、菜农清沟的工钱。低价并没有消除那些花费，只是把它们沿河送给了没有参与染布的人。
议会要求染坊修回沉淀池，并按排出的染水缴纳清理费。布价上涨了一些，何老板担心订单流失，却很快发现其他染坊也受同样规则约束。下游的清沟次数逐月减少。
月底结账时，何老板第一次在染料与柴火之间添上了一行：河水处理。
explanationParagraphs: A negative externality occurs when an activity imposes costs on third parties who did not take part in the decision, and those losses are not fully reflected in the producer's price. Private cost then falls below total cost, encouraging too much harmful activity. Regulation, charges, liability, technology, and collective governance can respond, though measurement, enforcement, fairness, and irreversible harm remain important.
explanationParagraphsZh: 负外部性发生在一项活动把成本施加给未参与决定的第三方，而这些损失没有充分进入制造者面对的价格。此时私人成本低于整体成本，活动可能过量。监管、收费、责任安排、技术与共同治理都可回应，但还需考虑测量、执行、公平和不可逆伤害。

articles.title: The Last Section of the Sea Wall
articles.summary: Four villages all want the completed sea wall but leave its final section to whoever is most likely to begin.
articles.summaryZh: 四个村庄都愿意享受完整海堤，却把最后一段留给了最可能先动手的人。
storyParagraphs: Four villages around the bay repaired the sea wall in front of their own land. Only one section at the river mouth remained open. It belonged to no village but protected every field. The eastern village said it had already moved the most stone. The western village said it lay farthest from the gap. North and south waited to see who would send workers first.

Every village agreed that a complete wall would help, and each feared that if it contributed, others would benefit for nothing. Several meetings produced promises but little work. Before the next high tide, a few stones lay beside the gap, with too few people to raise them.

A smaller tide entered the rice fields, though the damage remained limited. The villages then placed their work records on one shared board. Stone and labour days were assigned according to protected land and available workers. Anyone absent supplied grain instead, and completion was posted each evening.

Some still tried to work half a day less, while others challenged the shares as unfair. The recorder adjusted one household that truly had no available worker; every other missing day remained visible on the board. By the sixth day, the final section needed one capstone.
Representatives of all four villages lifted it together. After the stone settled, they did not erase the names from the board. They hung it inside the shared wall house.
storyParagraphsZh: 海湾四村各自修好了门前的海堤，只剩河口一段没有合拢。那一段不属于任何村，却保护所有田地。东村说自己已经搬石最多，西村说离缺口最远，南北两村都等着看别人是否先出人。
每个村都同意完整海堤有好处，也都担心自己出工后，其他村会白白受益。几次议事只留下口头承诺。涨潮前，缺口旁堆着少量石头，却没有足够的人把它们垒起来。
一次小潮灌进稻田，损失还不算大。四村这才把各自出工记录摆在同一块木板上，按受保护田地和可用劳力分配石料与工日；缺席者要用粮食补足，完成情况每天公开。
仍有人想少做半天，也有人争论分配不公。记录员当场调整了一户确实无人可出的份额，其余欠工则清楚留在木板上。到第六天，最后一段只差一块封顶石。
四村代表一起抬起那块石头。石头落下后，他们没有擦掉木板上的名字，而是把它挂进了共同的堤屋。
explanationParagraphs: A collective action problem occurs when everyone can benefit from a shared outcome, yet individual incentives, uncertainty, coordination costs, or opportunities to free ride prevent sufficient contribution. Solutions usually change information, monitoring, trust, contribution rules, and enforcement rather than merely appealing for cooperation. Fair, adaptable arrangements also matter for durability.
explanationParagraphsZh: 集体行动困境发生在人人都能从共同结果受益，但个体激励、协调成本、不确定性或搭便车机会阻止足够贡献。解决通常需要改变信息、监督、信任、贡献规则与执行方式，而非只呼吁合作。公平且可调整的安排也会影响规则能否维持。

articles.title: Three Keys to the Granary
articles.summary: The city's public grain is secured by three keys, and drought makes people resent how slowly they open the door.
articles.summaryZh: 城里的公粮被三把钥匙锁住，旱年到来时，人们第一次嫌它们开门太慢。
storyParagraphs: An earlier grain officer had once set levies, opened the store, and punished objections by himself. He eventually fled with half the grain. The city then fitted the public granary with three locks. The council decided when grain could be released, an officer carried out distribution, and the court reviewed disputes. No one could open the door alone.

In ordinary years, few complained. During a drought, the southern district requested an early release, but each body checked the case separately. The queue outside the granary grew. The mayor demanded all three keys and promised to open the store that day.

The grain officer also wanted speed, but found several shops belonging to the mayor's supporters on the list. The court paused distribution while the council published the damage records and removed ineligible names. The delay lasted another day, after which the granary opened under a corrected list.

The three bodies then created a time-limited emergency process. Two council representatives could authorise a small initial release, the officer had to record it immediately, and the court reviewed it the next day. The keys remained separate, but the steps could no longer drift without limit.
When the procedure was first used, the three keys turned in order. For every lock, a recorder wrote a name and time beside the door.
storyParagraphsZh: 旧粮官曾独自决定征粮、开仓和处罚异议者，最后带着半仓粮逃走。此后，城里给公仓换了三把锁：议事会决定何时放粮，粮官负责发放，法庭审查争议。任何一人都不能单独开门。
平年里，这套办法很少有人抱怨。旱年到来后，南区请求提前放粮，三方却要分别核对。队伍在仓外越排越长，市长要求把三把钥匙都交给自己，保证当天开仓。
粮官也想快一点，却发现市长提交的名单里混入几家支持者的商铺。法庭暂停发放，议事会公开受灾记录，删掉不合条件的名字。等待多了一日，仓门最终按修正名单打开。
三方随后为紧急情况增加一套限时程序：议事会两名代表可以先批准少量放粮，粮官当场登记，法庭在次日复核。钥匙仍分开，步骤却不再无限拖延。
第一次使用新程序时，三把钥匙依次转动。每开一把锁，记录员就在门边写下一个名字和时间。
explanationParagraphs: Separation of powers allocates rule-making, execution, and review of disputes to different institutions and uses checks to resist concentrated authority. It requires real independence, information, resources, and accountability. Separation is not complete isolation and can cause delay, so transparent, supervised coordination and emergency procedures also matter.
explanationParagraphsZh: 权力分立把制定规则、执行决定与审查争议等职能配置给不同机构，并通过制衡限制权力集中。它需要真实独立、信息、资源与问责程序。分立并非完全隔绝，也可能造成延迟，因此还需设计透明而受监督的协作和紧急机制。

articles.title: The Same Two Coins
articles.summary: Two collectors stand at the bridge and demand the same amount, but people hand over the coins with different expressions.
articles.summaryZh: 桥口先后来了两名收税人，索要的数目相同，人们交钱时的神情却完全不同。
storyParagraphs: After a flood damaged the stone bridge, its temporary keeper began charging two coins at the entrance on his own authority. He said the money would pay for repairs and barred anyone who refused. No one knew how long the charge would continue or saw an account book. Merchants paid because delay would cost them business.

A month later, the keeper had bought stone and the bridge was passable. He believed the result proved his right to keep collecting. Yet townspeople still took longer routes at night, and some paid only because guards with sticks stood behind him.

The council removed the private sign, published the repair budget, and asked elected district representatives to debate it. Some wanted three coins per cart; others wanted wealthy traders to pay more. The final rule still charged two coins, but only for six months. Accounts appeared each week, and overcharging could be appealed to an independent reviewer.

On the first day of the new rule, the same merchant again placed two coins at the bridge. He did not enjoy paying, but checked the date on his receipt and knew where a challenge could be made. The collector still exercised power, but its source had changed.
After six months, the box was removed as promised. Its final two coins were poured publicly into the repair account.
storyParagraphsZh: 洪水冲坏石桥后，临时守桥人擅自在桥头收两枚钱。他说钱会拿去修桥，拒绝交钱的人不能通过。没人知道收费要持续多久，也没人见过账本。商贩怕耽误生意，只得照付。
一个月后，守桥人果然买了石料，桥也能走了。他认为成果已经证明自己有权继续收费。可镇民仍在夜里绕远路，有人付钱只是因为他身后站着持棍的守卫。
镇议会撤掉私设木牌，公开桥梁预算，让各区选出的代表讨论。有人主张每车三枚，有人要求富商多付。最终通过的仍是每车两枚，期限六个月，账目每周张贴，超收可向独立审理人申诉。
新规第一天，同一名商贩又把两枚钱放在桥口。他并不喜欢缴费，却停下来核对收据上的日期，也知道自己能去哪里质疑。守桥人手中仍有权力，权力的来处却已经不同。
六个月后，收费员按规定拆下木箱。箱底最后两枚钱被当众倒进修桥账袋。
explanationParagraphs: Political legitimacy asks what gives authority a justified right to issue binding decisions and what might ground a duty to comply. Consent, fair procedure, public reason, rights protection, and effective provision may all matter. People's actual belief in legitimacy and an authority's normative justification overlap but are not identical; legitimacy is also distinct from force or popularity.
explanationParagraphsZh: 政治合法性追问权威凭什么拥有作出有约束力决定的正当权利，以及服从义务可能来自何处。有效成果、同意、公平程序、公共理由、权利保护等都可能相关。人们实际相信权威正当，与它在规范上是否真正正当，是相连但不同的问题；合法性也不等于单纯强制或受欢迎。

articles.title: The Bridge That Improved Only in the Record
articles.summary: After an engineer signs the approval, the cracks do not shrink, but the words describing them become gentler each week.
articles.summaryZh: 工程师签下验收单后，桥上的裂缝没有缩小，记录里的形容词却一天比一天温和。
storyParagraphs: Engineer Wei Cen was known for caution. If the new bridge opened by month's end, his bonus would repay a workshop loan. Before approval, he found three fine cracks in a pier and still signed 'fit for passage', telling himself they were only surface shrinkage.

After opening, an apprentice measured the cracks each week. The numbers increased slowly. Wei Cen changed 'widening' in the record to 'seasonal movement' and removed the words 'immediate inspection required'. He did not want to become a careless person. Each altered phrase made his signature and his view of himself easier to hold together.

Before the rainy season, a small corner of stone fell into the river. No one was hurt, but the mayor requested the original records. The apprentice produced the first measurement sheet she had kept. In Wei Cen's own hand it said, 'If widening continues, close the bridge.'

Wei Cen remained in his office until dark. He could argue that the fallen stone was unrelated, or admit that he had spent the weeks after approval finding reasons for his earlier decision. The next morning, he closed the bridge himself, returned the bonus, and restored every softened phrase.
When repairs began, the first measurement sheet was pinned beside the bridge. Wei Cen did not cut away his signature.
storyParagraphsZh: 工程师魏岑一直以谨慎闻名。新桥若在月底开放，他能拿到足够偿还作坊贷款的奖金。验收前，他在桥墩上发现三道细裂纹，仍签下了“可以通行”，告诉自己裂纹只是表面收缩。
开放后，学徒每周量一次裂纹。数字缓慢增加，魏岑却把记录从“扩展”改成“季节变化”，又删去“需立即复查”。他不是想成为不负责的人；每一次改词，都让签字与他对自己的看法不再那么冲突。
雨季前，一小块石角落进河里。没人受伤，市长要求看原始记录。学徒拿出自己保留的第一张测量纸，上面仍有魏岑亲手写的“若继续增宽，应封桥”。
魏岑在办公室坐到天黑。他可以说石角与裂纹无关，也可以承认验收后一直在替原决定寻找理由。第二天，他主动封桥，退回奖金，并把后来改过的词逐一恢复。
维修开始时，那张最早的测量纸被钉在桥边。魏岑没有把自己的签名裁掉。
explanationParagraphs: Cognitive dissonance is the discomfort created when important beliefs, commitments, actions, and evidence conflict. People may reduce it by changing behaviour or belief, adding justifications, selecting information, or minimising the inconsistency. It is not the same as ordinary uncertainty or deliberate hypocrisy; it often arises while protecting a self-image or prior decision.
explanationParagraphsZh: 认知失调是重要信念、承诺、行动与证据不一致时产生的心理不适。人们可能通过改变行为或信念、增加理由、选择信息或淡化冲突来减轻它。这个过程不等于普通不确定或故意虚伪；它常在维护自我形象与既有决定时发生。

articles.title: One Grain on the Blue Board
articles.summary: A pigeon learns to land on a blue platform not because the colour commands it, but because one grain follows each landing.
articles.summaryZh: 信鸽学会落在蓝木片上，不是因为认得颜色，而是因为每次落下后都有一粒谷。
storyParagraphs: Postal apprentice Qinghe had to teach a group of new pigeons to land on a blue receiving platform. At first, they settled on the roof, window frames, and water barrel. One bird happened to step across the blue board, and Qinghe immediately placed a grain there.

On the next attempt, she rewarded the bird for coming near the board. Later, grain appeared only after it landed fully. Within days, it flew to the blue platform upon entering the yard. Other pigeons received grain after the same action, while stopping elsewhere produced nothing.

A fellow apprentice decided the colour itself must be magical and scattered grain across the yard in advance. Once full, the birds returned to the roof and the blue platform lost its importance. Qinghe removed the scattered food and again made grain follow a landing. The behaviour gradually returned.

After the station opened, Qinghe reduced how often food appeared, though correct landings were still rewarded from time to time. When some pigeons returned to the old roof after a long period without grain, she briefly restored the immediate reward.
At dusk, the final carrier landed on the blue board. Qinghe waited until both feet were steady before taking one grain from her pouch.
storyParagraphsZh: 邮站学徒青禾要教一群新信鸽落在蓝色接信台上。起初，鸽子停在屋檐、窗框和水桶上，只有一只偶然踩过蓝木片。青禾立刻在木片上放下一粒谷。
下一次，那只鸽子靠近木片时，青禾便给谷；后来只有真正落上去才给。几天后，它一进院子就飞向蓝台。其他鸽子也在相同行动之后得到谷，停错地方则什么也没有。
同伴以为蓝色本身有魔力，把谷提前撒满院子。鸽子吃饱后重新停满屋檐，蓝台不再特别。青禾收起散谷，让食物再次紧跟在落上木片之后，行为才慢慢回来。
邮站正式启用时，青禾逐渐减少给谷的次数，却仍偶尔在正确落台后留下食物。没有回报很久以后，有几只鸽子又开始停向旧屋檐，她便恢复几次及时奖励。
傍晚，最后一只信鸽落在蓝木片上。青禾等它双脚站稳，才从袋里取出一粒谷。
explanationParagraphs: Operant conditioning describes how behaviour changes with its consequences. Reinforcement makes a behaviour more likely in the future, while punishment makes it less likely; learning depends on the consequence following and depending on the action. Rewarding successive approximations can shape behaviour, while withholding the consequence can weaken it. Positive and negative mean adding or removing a stimulus, not good and bad.
explanationParagraphsZh: 操作性条件作用描述行为如何随其后果改变。强化使行为未来更可能出现，惩罚使其更少；学习取决于后果是否紧随并取决于该行为。逐步奖励接近目标的动作可以塑造行为，而不再提供后果会使行为减弱。正负指增加或移除刺激，不代表好坏。

articles.title: The Lazy Man Beside the Raised Bridge
articles.summary: A warehouse owner decides that a new porter is always late until she waits forty minutes at the same bridge.
articles.summaryZh: 仓主认定新搬运工总是迟到，直到自己在同一座桥前等了四十分钟。
storyParagraphs: New porter Shiye arrived late three days in a row. Warehouse owner Luo Niang was rushing to complete rainy-season orders. Seeing him enter out of breath, she decided that the young man was lazy and did not take work seriously. Shiye explained that the river bridge opened for cargo boats each morning. Luo Niang replied that a punctual person would leave earlier.

On the fourth day, she deducted his pay. Shiye began leaving before dawn. Sometimes he arrived on time; sometimes an extra vessel kept the bridge raised. At the warehouse, people saw only the moment he entered, not the changing queue beside the river.

A week later, Luo Niang crossed to the southern bank to collect an account. She allowed an extra half hour, but a salt boat became stuck and the bridge remained raised. She arrived forty minutes late. The bookkeeper asked jokingly whether she did not care about the business. Luo Niang did not answer.

The next day, she did not simply abandon every attendance rule. She examined a month of bridge records and compared arrival times for workers from different streets. Shiye had never been late on a morning when the bridge stayed down. She moved his shift by half an hour while still requiring reasons for any delay.
Luo Niang tore up the penalty slip marked 'lazy', kept the date, and wrote instead, 'Delayed by bridge opening.'
storyParagraphsZh: 新搬运工石野连续三天迟到。仓主罗娘正赶一批雨季订单，看见他喘着气进门，便认定这个年轻人懒散、不把工作当回事。石野解释河桥每天清晨会为货船升闸，罗娘只觉得守时的人应当更早出门。
第四天，罗娘扣了他的工钱。石野此后天不亮便出发，有时准时，有时仍被临时增加的货船挡住。仓里只看见他推门的时刻，看不见桥边长短不定的队伍。
一周后，罗娘要去南岸收账，亲自走了同一条路。她预留了半个时辰，桥闸却因一艘卡住的盐船迟迟不落。到达时，她也晚了四十分钟。账房笑问她是不是不重视生意，罗娘没有回答。
第二天，她没有直接撤销所有要求，而是查看一个月的升闸记录，又比较住在不同街区的工人到岗时间。石野在桥不升起的日子从未迟到。她把他的班次推迟半个时辰，同时要求迟到仍须登记原因。
罗娘把原来写着“懒散”的罚单撕掉，留下日期，重新写成“因升闸延误”。
explanationParagraphs: The fundamental attribution error is the tendency to overemphasise personal traits or attitudes when explaining another person's behaviour and to underweight less visible situational influences. It does not mean traits never matter. Better judgement compares behaviour across times and settings and seeks evidence that distinguishes disposition from external constraint.
explanationParagraphsZh: 基本归因错误是解释他人行为时过度强调性格、态度等个人特质，而低估不易看见的情境影响。它不表示特质永远无关。更可靠的判断会比较不同时间与情境，并寻找能区分个人倾向和外部约束的证据。
